help.homecraftguild.guild.beds_1: • A member has one active bound bed. Choosing a new one frees the old bed.
help.homecraftguild.guild.beds_2: • Another player’s bound bed cannot be overwritten or used as your spawn.
help.homecraftguild.guild.beds_3: • Guildmasters and Builders can place many free beds for members.
help.homecraftguild.guild.bonuses_1: • Guilds grant base +5% XP and +10% helpful potion duration; stronger bonuses unlock through talents.
help.homecraftguild.guild.bonuses_2: • Armor receives a bonus only when it is actually equipped.
help.homecraftguild.guild.bonuses_3: • Weapon bonus works for swords, axes, maces, tridents, bows, and crossbows. Pickaxes, hoes, shovels, blocks, and materials do not receive weapon bonus.
help.homecraftguild.guild.golem_stats_1: • Normal golems have static +300% max HP from base and +50% damage.
help.homecraftguild.guild.golem_stats_2: • Elite golems have static +500% max HP from base and +75% damage.
help.homecraftguild.guild.golem_stats_3: • During the day, healing is top priority when HP is below 50% of the guild maximum.
help.homecraftguild.guild.golem_stats_4: • The golem heals to 100% and must not reset to vanilla HP after restart or respawn.
help.homecraftguild.guild.golem_stats_5: • At night, golems stay closer to members on the surface without chasing underground targets.
help.homecraftguild.guild.golems_3: • Elite golem unlocks at level 5. Limit: one elite golem per guild.
help.homecraftguild.guild.golems_4: • Elite price: 50 emeralds at level 5, 60 at level 6, 70 at level 7.
help.homecraftguild.guild.totem_1: • A totem creates protected territory. Adjacent totems of the same guild work as one space.
help.homecraftguild.guild.totem_2: • Totem recipe: ABA / BEB / ABA. A is amethyst shard, B is any banner, E is emerald.
help.homecraftguild.guild.totem_3: • Only the Guildmaster can place a totem. It cannot be placed on spawn, inside another territory, overlapping territory, or over the territory limit.
help.homecraftguild.guild.what_1: • A guild is a team with its own territory, roles, beds, progression, and defenders.
help.homecraftguild.guild.what_2: • The main goal is to build a safe base, level up, unlock larger territory limits, and hire guards.
help.homecraftguild.guild.what_3: • The Guildmaster manages roles, invites, territories, and golem purchases. Builders help with the base and beds.

screen.homecraftguild.achievements.title: Guild Achievements
screen.homecraftguild.create.help.line_1: • The Guildmaster places the totem outside spawn protection and away from overlapping enemy territory.
• Each totem creates territory; adjacent territories of the same guild work as one space.
• A member can bind one active bed inside guild territory.
• A new binding frees the old one. Another player's bound bed is not overwritten.
• Normal golem: +300% max HP from base and +50% damage.
• Elite golem: +500% max HP from base and +75% damage.
screen.homecraftguild.create.help.line_2: • A guild is a team with roles, owned territories, beds, golems and progression.
• Normal prices: 1, 3, 10 and 20 emeralds for the 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th golem.
• Elite golem unlocks at level 5, limit 1. Cost: 50 emeralds at level 5, 60 at level 6, 70 at level 7.
• During the day, a golem below 50% of guild max HP heals at the totem first until 100% HP.
• At night, golems support members on the surface but do not chase underground targets into mines.
• A guild gives base +5% XP and +10% duration for helpful potions; stronger bonuses unlock through talents.
• Armor bonus works only on equipped armor; weapon bonus works only on real weapons.
• An axe is a weapon. Pickaxes, hoes, shovels, blocks and materials do not receive the weapon bonus.
screen.homecraftguild.create.help.line_3: • The Guildmaster manages roles, members, invitations, totems and golem hiring.
screen.homecraftguild.create.help.line_4: • The Builder helps with territory and can place many free beds for members.
screen.homecraftguild.create.help.line_7: • Craft the Guild Crystal Totem item.
screen.homecraftguild.create.help.line_9: • A — amethyst shard, B — any banner, E — emerald.
